en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing an illustration of two barefoot men in tunics carrying an enormous cluster of grapes on a pole between them, walking through a hilly vineyard landscape with a chapel or small church on a hill in the background. Large grapevines frame the scene on both sides. The Latin phrase "IN VINO VERITAS" appears prominently at the bottom of the image. Beneath this, printed in red Czech text, is a caption describing the subject as a wall painting in the manor wine cellars in Liběchov near Mělník.
